MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.tenant_id IN $tenant_ids AND d.path IN $paths RETURN max(d.version) AS max_version

MERGE (d:Document {tenant_id: $tenant_id, path: $path, version: $version}) SET d.name = $name, d.load_date = $load_date, d.is_folder = $is_folder, d.raw_file_id = $raw_file_id, d.context_instructions = $context_instructions, d.created_by_user_id = $created_by_user_id, d.job_id = $job_id, d.latest = true, d.file_captured_at = $file_captured_at, d.file_device_make = $file_device_make, d.file_device_model = $file_device_model, d.file_gps_latitude = $file_gps_latitude, d.file_gps_longitude = $file_gps_longitude, d.file_width = $file_width, d.file_height = $file_height, d.file_duration_ms = $file_duration_ms, d.file_container = $file_container, d.file_audio_codec = $file_audio_codec, d.file_video_codec = $file_video_codec, d.file_frame_rate = $file_frame_rate

MATCH (old:Document {tenant_id: $tenant_id, path: $path, latest: true}) WHERE old.version <> $new_version MATCH (new:Document {tenant_id: $tenant_id, path: $path, version: $new_version}) SET old.latest = false MERGE (old)-[:HAS_NEWER_VERSION]->(new)

MERGE (n:StructureNode {id: $id}) SET n:Section, n.node_id = $node_id, n.role = $role, n.appearance_order = $appearance_order, n.title = $title, n.theme = $theme, n.source_page_ids = $source_page_ids, n.tenant_id = $tenant_id, n.created_by_user_id = $created_by_user_id, n.job_id = $job_id
MATCH (d:Document {tenant_id: $tenant_id, path: $doc_path, version: $version}) MATCH (n:StructureNode {id: $node_id}) MERGE (d)-[:HAS_STRUCTURE]->(n)
